fields.question: What type of change is planned?
What specifically changes? Include the affected setting or behavior and the before/after state.
When is the change planned? Include the time zone, or say Not yet decided.
How will the change be rolled out? Describe the steps or say Not yet defined.
What is the rollback plan and when would you use it? Say Not yet defined if missing.
How will you validate success, monitor regressions and identify a rollback trigger? Say Not yet defined if missing.
